info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Limestone Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Limestone Laptop Detail Management API is designed to facilitate the creation of detailed product specifications for laptops in the Limestone catalog. This API allows businesses to input and manage detailed information about laptop models, making it easier for consumers to access comprehensive data. Typical users of this API include product managers and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance their online product offerings. By integrating this API, businesses can ensure they provide rich and informative product listings that meet customer needs.

post.summary: Create details for a Limestone laptop.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed specifications for a Limestone laptop, including features, configurations, and other relevant information. The data submitted will be used to enhance product listings and inform potential buyers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details about a Limestone laptop. It should contain all necessary attributes required for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning laptop details.
